answer_1.quote: We formulate the task of adaptive syntactically-controlled paraphrase generation as: given an input sentence X, find a set of proper syntactic controls Y to generate paraphrases Z ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of paraphrases with: 1) alignment-based metrics ... BLEU, ROUGE scores and METEOR ... 2) syntactic conformation metrics: Tree-Edit Distances (TED) scores ...

answer_4.quote: We validate the chosen paraphrases for the first 100 instances in the test sets on Amazon Mturk, and report as Valid@100 ... workers were asked to judge if paraphrase is natural, fluent, and preserves the semantics of the source sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to label a paraphrase as valid only when it is natural, fluent, and preserves the semantics of the source sentence.
